_comment: US Navy DD Form 1289, handwritten, dated 23 Jan 99. A compounded preparation written in classic apothecary form: two ingredients combined into one solution rather than two separate medications. 'Tr. Belladonna' is tincture of belladonna; 'Amphogel' is aluminium hydroxide gel; 'qsad 120 ml' means make up to 120 ml. 'Sig: 5ml t.i.d. a.c.' is 5 ml three times daily before meals. The two-digit year 99 is unambiguous in context (the form is dated 1 NOV 71 and the exp date is 12/02), so 1999 is recorded.

medications.instructions: 5 ml three times daily before meals
